description: A PostHog cohort: a named group of persons defined by property and behavioral filters (or a HogQL query), used to filter insights, target feature flags and build audiences.

ApiKey.description: PostHog personal API key (phx_...) with the scopes this resource type needs. Pass it with a dynamic reference such as {{resolve:ssm-secure:/posthog/api-key}} when calling SetTypeConfiguration; never put it in plain text.

BaseUrl.description: PostHog API host. Leave unset for PostHog Cloud US (https://us.posthog.com); use https://eu.posthog.com for PostHog Cloud EU, or your instance URL when self-hosting.

ProjectId.description: ID of the PostHog project the cohort belongs to.

Filters.description: Cohort membership filters as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString): an object with a `properties` filter group, e.g. {"properties": {"type": "OR", "values": [{"type": "AND", "values": [{"key": "email", "type": "person", "value": "@example.com", "operator": "icontains"}]}]}}.

Query.description: HogQL query that defines the cohort's members, as JSON (use Fn::ToJsonString). Used instead of Filters for query-based cohorts.

IsStatic.description: Whether the cohort is static (a fixed list of persons, filled in PostHog) rather than computed from Filters. Cannot be changed after creation.

CohortType.description: Type of cohort. PostHog derives it from the filters when not set.
